name: modbee-mqtt
description: MQTT and Sparkplug B inside an OpenPLC program: FB_MqttClient connects plain or over TLS, on a board over Wi-Fi, Ethernet or cellular or on the Runtime, with publishing, subscribing and request/response as its methods; FB_SparkplugNode and FB_SparkplugHost report to and read from SCADA, FB_MqttBroker makes the PLC the site broker and FB_MqttBridge links two brokers. Nothing here blocks the scan and every setting may change while it runs; the library's documentation covers the rest.
